履修条件
春学期以外は水共生学と受講生各自の研究テーマをあわせた内容を個別に設定します．受講生は各自の研究テーマと水共生学の関連について事前に検討して下さい．
Outside the spring semester, the course content will be individually tailored based on each student’s research topic. Students are expected to consider in advance how their individual research topics relate to this lecture.
授業概要
水循環や水循環が社会に及ぼす影響、さらにはその相互関係について分析するための手法、分析した結果を課題解決のために社会実装するための手法について学ぶ。受講者は具体的な研究課題を題材として演習や発表・議論を行うことで、水文学をはじめとする関連分野の基礎的素養と分析能力を身に着ける。
This course is designed to provide students with the methods for analyzing the hydrological cycle and its impact on society, as well as its interrelationships, and the methods for implementing the results of analysis in society in order to solve problems. Students will acquire basic knowledge and analytical skills in hydrology and other related fields through exercises, presentations, and discussions on specific research topics.
